text:
liam: Heads up — I pushed a tiny refactor in PR #2387 that moves some helper funcs around. CI is green except for a lint/gofmt error that only shows up on the runner.
jen: @liam can you paste the failing snippet?
liam: sure — the runner flagged a trailing comma + an exported name mismatch after the rename. gist: https://gist.github.com/xxx (short)
maya: can you run `gofmt -w` locally and push? sometimes the formatter rules are stricter in our CI image.
liam: tried that, still saw the failure. here's the exact linter output:
```
cmd/handler/handler.go:142:2: exported type HelperFunc should have comment or be unexported (golint)
cmd/handler/handler.go:210:5: trailing comma in composite literal (gofmt)
```
zach: the exported name change is deliberate from helperFunc -> HelperFunc because it's used in tests in another package — fine to keep but we need the comment.
olivia: short policy: if you expose a type, add a one-line comment. for this PR just add `// HelperFunc is a small adapter used by test harness` above the type.
liam: ok adding that. for the trailing comma, I can't reproduce locally — ci-bot image uses go1.20 and `gofumpt`. can someone with that setup confirm?
ci-bot: deploy-image: go1.20 + gofumpt v0.4.0. Lint job: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/98765
jen: I can run the same image locally via docker. give me 10m.
maya: if jen's good with the quick fix, can we get an approval from @zach (owner for handler package) and merge in the afternoon slot? small change, low risk. :clock3:
jen: ran the image — reproduced. `gofmt` wasn't the issue, it's `gofumpt` stricter formatting. `gofumpt -w` fixes it. pushing a commit with both the comment and the gofumpt formatting unless you want to handle it, @liam?
liam: please go ahead, thanks. I'll rebase after.
zach: quick note — since this changes public type comment, pls include a short changelog line in the PR description (under "changelog: internal").\oli via DM: @liam also add yourself to the reviewers list for next time — we missed one owner in CODEOWNERS so I updated it in a subsequent commit.
liam: will do. jen, thanks for the fix — can you add `Signed-off-by: jen` in the commit message?
jen: done, pushed `jen/gofumpt-fix`. CI now: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/98766 (green)
maya: looks good to me. @zach please review and approve when you have a sec.
zach: taking a quick look... lgtm. small nit: prefer `// HelperFunc adapts X to Y` wording but not blocking. approving now. :white_check_mark:
liam: thanks all — merging into main during the 16:00 merge window.
jen: :shipit: 
maya: :thumbsup: 
ci-bot: merged PR #2387 into main by jen (merge method: rebase).
